name: Pirate Weather
tagline: Dark Sky–compatible free weather API replacement
description: Pirate Weather is a free weather API that provides a Dark Sky–compatible replacement after Apple shut down the Dark Sky API. It offers current conditions, forecasts, and historical weather data via a simple REST API.

auth.details: API key via path parameter in the URL (self-serve signup).

use_cases: get current weather for a location
get hourly and daily weather forecasts
get historical weather data for a location
